facts: NativeRuntime launches native_worker via actual inner tmux new-session and configures default-terminal tmux-256color.
Serialized launch environment may reflect the terminal which prepared the launch; existing rebinding already replaces TMUX and TMUX_PANE with actual worker environment.
Rebinding TERM in the same loop uses actual inner-terminal capabilities and removes stale serialized TERM if actual worker TERM is absent.
CODEX_HOME and all other launch environment entries retain exact previous behavior.
Strengthened existing test compares the entire final environment for actual tmux-256color and absent TERM, preserving all previous TMUX/CODEX_HOME assertions.
limitations: A TERM consistency fix is not evidence that TERM caused the buffered-input timeout.
Actual child TERM/default-terminal observation and supervised runtime regressions remain required.
merge_note: Native-worker source is disjoint from the UX proposal; the edited old test function precedes UX appended tests in test_terminal_bridge.py. Preserve both changes when combining proposals.
